notes.title: Crimson Desert Has Been Nominated at the gamescom Awards!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Crimson Desert has been nominated for the following categories at the 2025 gamescom Awards! [p align="justify"]Best Visuals 
[p align="justify"]Most Epic 
[p align="justify"]Best Microsoft Xbox Game 
[p align="justify"]Best Sony PlayStation Game 


It is an incredible honor to be nominated, and it would not have been possible without our amazing community. As always, thank you for being part of this adventure with us. 

If you’d like to support us, you can cast your vote in the categories Crimson Desert has been nominated for through the link below.

[p align="justify"]Vote here: \[Link] 
[p align="justify"]Voting period: (Wed) August 20, 00:00 ~ (Thur) August 21, 05:00 (PDT)


Thank you for your vote and your continued support, and see you soon in Pywel at gamescom!

notes.title: Play Crimson Desert at gamescom and PAX West 2025!
notes.content:
From Cologne to Seattle, Crimson Desert will first be at gamescom and then heading right over to PAX West this August!  If you're planning on attending, make sure to visit the Pearl Abyss booth and play the new public hands-on demo. Experience a part of the Crimson Desert story where you'll be joining Kliff as he arrives on the battlefields of Calphade in search of one of his Greymane comrades.  We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Dev Archives: A Look into Pearl Abyss’ BlackSpace Engine
notes.content:
2025 Game Developers Conference Recap

[previewyoutube=WEBAgTozBEU;full][/previewyoutube]
(Footage in the above video was captured in-engine and may differ from the final game.)
Behind closed doors at this year's GDC, we revealed a peek into the engine behind Crimson Desert - Pearl Abyss’ in-house BlackSpace Engine. Here are just a few of the details the engine makes possible in-game to breathe life into the land of Pywel!
Watch those details come to life. Seeing is believing as they say.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343476/8b0ec3dc376e958943b5fff715f4846882796259.jpg
Immersive Details Both Big and Small
Shallow Water Feature
 [code]The BlackSpace Engine steps up the realism in water flow and tides by simulating collision with the environment through the Shallow Water feature. [/code] 
Volumetric Fog with Fluid Simulation
 [code]Volumetric fog with fluid simulation adds an eerie touch to this environment as the fog reacts to every step, hop, and roll.[/code]
Timelapse (Atmospheric Scattering)
 [code]Good morning, afternoon, evening, and night! The day and night cycle running in tune with real-time lighting and detailed atmospheric scattering brings another layer of realism to the world.[/code] 
GPU-based Cloth and Hair Simulation
 [code]Any way the wind blows, cloth and hair will flutter and sway in a natural and familiar way. [/code]
Raytracing
 [code]The engine's real-time lighting calculations enable realistic looking surroundings with Raytracing off but enhance your surroundings even further with Raytracing on. [/code]
